title: Niederer et al. 2011 N-version benchmark: activation time at P1-P9

sources.citation: Niederer SA, Kerfoot E, Benson AP, et al. Verification of cardiac tissue electrophysiology simulators using an N-version benchmark. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 369(1954):4331-4351 (2011)
sources.note: open-access full text (PMC3263775, mirrored by Europe PMC) and Figure 1 (rsta20110139-g1.jpg)

sources.citation: Electronic supplementary material of the same article: the per-code activation times at P1-P9
sources.note: behind a bot check on 2026-09-26; not retrieved. Corrected 2026-09-26 (controller review M8): this note previously said the ESM 'would hold Niederer's own per-point coordinate table'. What the paper actually says it holds (Figure 1 caption) is narrower: 'activation times at points P1-P9 were evaluated and are available in the electronic supplementary material' -- times, not a stated coordinate table. P2, P3, P6 and P7's coordinates come instead from the owner's paper appendix (source niederer2011-owner-appendix), whose P2/P3 naming order this file has not cross-checked against this ESM

sources.citation: Project owner's manuscript appendix, 'Niederer Benchmark Protocol' (ElectrophysiologySolver, paperI_methods_publication/appendices/niederer_protocol.qmd), table 'Probe | Position (mm)' (@tbl-niederer-probe-activation) and the 'Activation-time extraction and sampling' section — an unpublished project document, not the primary source
sources.note: Read-only, outside this repository: /Users/simaocastro/Documents/Latex_papers/ElectrophysiologySolver/sections/paperI_methods_publication/appendices/niederer_protocol.qmd. States P1-P9 in the appendix's own cardiacFOAM frame (slab 20x3x7 mm; axes x=20mm edge, y=3mm edge, z=7mm edge; stimulus box at high z). Converted here to this file's frame (origin at P1, the stimulus corner; axis 1 = 20 mm edge, axis 2 = 7 mm edge, axis 3 = 3 mm edge) via (x, y_cf, z_cf) -> (x, 7 - z_cf, y_cf). The converted P1, P8, P9 and the four vertical pairings (P1-P5, P2-P6, P3-P7, P4-P8, each differing only in axis 3) match every constraint niederer2011 itself states. The P2/P3 (and hence P6/P7) naming order is this appendix's own convention; it has not been independently checked against niederer2011's ESM (source niederer2011-esm, not retrieved). Controller resolution recorded 2026-09-26 in .superpowers/sdd/niederer-benchmark-definition.md, section 'Resolution of P2-P7'

quantity.name: activation time
quantity.definition: the time at which the membrane potential first passes through 0 mV

source.where: section 3f (metric); milliseconds throughout, section 3d and Figures 2-4

frame.definition: A convention adopted by this file; the paper prints no coordinates. Origin at P1, the stimulus corner. Axis 1 runs along the 20 mm edge (the fibre direction), axis 2 along the 7 mm edge, axis 3 along the 3 mm edge, each pointing into the slab. The slab's dimensions (20 x 7 x 3 mm), its fibre axis and the stimulus corner are the paper's.

source.where: section 3b and Table 3 (dimensions, fibres along the 20 mm axis); section 3c (stimulus at one corner); Figure 1b (P1 at that corner)

points.label: P1
points.definition: the corner where the stimulus is delivered; the P1-P8 line starts here

points.label: P2
points.definition: the corner adjacent to P1, displaced along the 7 mm edge (P1's bottom, 3 mm-axis, face); the P2-P6 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: table 'Probe | Position (mm)', probe P2, frame-converted; naming order (7 mm edge vs 20 mm edge) is this appendix's convention, not independently checked against niederer2011's ESM

points.label: P3
points.definition: the corner adjacent to P1, displaced along the 20 mm (fibre) edge (P1's bottom, 3 mm-axis, face); the P3-P7 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: table 'Probe | Position (mm)', probe P3, frame-converted; naming order (20 mm edge vs 7 mm edge) is this appendix's convention, not independently checked against niederer2011's ESM

points.label: P4
points.definition: the corner of P1's 3 mm-axis face diagonally opposite P1; P8 lies directly above it along the 3 mm edge

points.label: P5
points.definition: the corner above P1 along the 3 mm edge; the P1-P5 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: table 'Probe | Position (mm)', probe P5, frame-converted; the P1-P5 vertical pairing this yields matches Figure 1b's construction line

points.label: P6
points.definition: the corner above P2 along the 3 mm edge; the P2-P6 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: table 'Probe | Position (mm)', probe P6, frame-converted; follows P2, whose naming order is the appendix's convention

points.label: P7
points.definition: the corner above P3 along the 3 mm edge; the P3-P7 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: table 'Probe | Position (mm)', probe P7, frame-converted; follows P3, whose naming order is the appendix's convention

points.label: P8
points.definition: the corner diagonally opposite P1 through the slab; the P1-P8 line ends here, and it activates last

source.where: Figure 1 caption; section 5; section 5b (the far corner); section 6
